title: Kanokon: Manatsu no Dai Shanikusai

alternative_titles.ja: かのこん ～真夏の大謝肉祭～

synopsis:
As the summer arrives, everyone is excited to make the most out of their vacation. The same goes for Kouta Oyamada, but with Chizuru Minamoto constantly trying to tease him and get his attention, things do not go as intended. However, when the two learn about the upcoming summer festival, they decide to participate. With their friends also getting into the festival spirit, Kouta and Chizuru hope to make memories for years to come.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
